prompt: int Which functions in src/shop/pricing.py are never called anywhere in the repo?
message: `legacy_price` is the only unused function in `src/shop/pricing.py:20-21` — it's never imported or called anywhere else in the repo. The other three (`with_vat`, `discount`, `round_cents`) are all used by `src/shop/cart.py`, and `round_cents` is also called directly in `tests/test_pricing.py`.
